title: Hai Karbala kay bun mein ghareeboun ka Arbayeen
body:
Hai Karbala kay bun mein ghareeboun ka Arbayeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir kay mazaar pa Zainab ki hai jabeen
Aansoo bahaa rahey hain khadey Abid-e-hazeen
Abaad thi Hussain kay qadhmoun sey yeh zameen
Ab haal yeh hai sar pa koyi saayebaan nahin
<<MINI>>
Hai Karbala kay bun mein ghareeboun ka Arbayeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Maajaaye pehlay aag lagi khaimagaaha mai
Har gaam ek taaza qayaamat thi raaha mai
Bachchi ki hichkiyoun ka hai manzar nigaaha mai
Zindaan-e-Shaam mai hai Sakina yahaan nahin
<<MINI>>
Hai Karbala kay bun mein ghareeboun ka Arbayeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas-e-naamwar jo harum ka tha paasbaan
Rothi thi yaad karkay jisey saari bibiyaan
Bey aas jiski laash pah thay Shaahey doh jahaan
Laasha kahin tha haath kahin aur Alam kahin
<<MINI>>
Hai Karbala kay bun mein ghareeboun ka Arbayeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhaiyya hamaarey waadey ki takmeel hogayi
Aisa safar huva hai kay sar par ridaa na thi
Darbaar-e-Shaam mai thi qayaamat ki beybasi
Rudaad-e-gham sunaaney ki taaqath bhi ab nahin
<<MINI>>
Hai Karbala kay bun mein ghareeboun ka Arbayeen
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahley jahaan ko hogi agar haq ki justaju
Akhtar asar dikhaayega mazloom ka lahu
Hai ghamzadaa bahan ki yehi ek aarzu
Aabaad zaayereen sey hojaaye yeh zameen
<<MINI>>
Hai Karbala kay bun mein ghareeboun ka Arbayeen
author: Akhtar Zaidi
